title: Red mercury black market after the Soviet collapse
summary: Kurt McConnell tells of Red mercury black market after the Soviet collapse, about late 1980s-1990s at Former Soviet Union, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: coming out of the former Soviet Union were all these stories about this substance called red mercury that was uh alleged to have these amazing properties and that it was being sold on the black market and so on.

plain: Kirk McConnell, a former staffer for the US Senate, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about red mercury. He says that as the Soviet Union fell apart in the late 1980s and 1990s, many stories came out about this substance, which was said to have amazing properties and was supposedly being sold on the black market. The stories matter because they hint at secret materials with powers beyond known science.
